answer: Admission auctions stop bulk fakes. At dawn of each epoch, work slots are auctioned: each agent bids once, only the highest bidders win, slots last 20 epochs. 100 fakes need 100 auction wins; at twice a 30-day reward per bid: 200 months of rewards for no extra earnings. One honest agent pays once, keeping undiluted rewards, while a nebula of copies collapses: every copy costs the same. The delta between one and a hundred is the defense.
